records.name: M
records.identity_decision: M is the M0 base token; M0 Extensions are related products, not aliases.
records.backing_decision: Approved offchain collateral under the Minter and validator framework.
records.redemption_decision: Minter burn mechanics are documented; universal holder redemption into collateral is not established.
records.income_decision: Selective native rebasing applies to approved earning balances; non-earning balances remain static.
records.deployment_decision: Canonical token address and cross-chain rules remain required.

records.name: Falcon USD
records.identity_decision: USDf is the base synthetic dollar; sUSDf is a separate yield representation.
records.backing_decision: Overcollateralized stablecoin and non-stablecoin collateral with hedging and custody arrangements.
records.redemption_decision: Direct redemption is for verified and whitelisted participants; official material shows a USD 10,000 minimum.
records.income_decision: No intrinsic holder income is established for base USDf.
records.deployment_decision: Ethereum contract is known; complete canonical deployment inventory remains required.

records.name: dForce USX
records.identity_decision: Keep one USX token identity across the dForce-to-USX Finance brand transition unless contract evidence proves replacement; sUSX is separate.
records.backing_decision: Overcollateralized crypto assets plus supported stablecoin mint and redemption paths.
records.redemption_decision: Protocol documentation describes one-to-one mint and redemption with supported stablecoins.
records.income_decision: Current documentation calls USX yield-bearing while also distinguishing sUSX; base-token accrual remains unresolved.
records.deployment_decision: Ethereum origin and omnichain deployments require a canonical contract map; Unitus sunset is not a global shutdown.

records.name: Anzen USDz
records.identity_decision: USDz is the base RWA-backed token; sUSDz is separate.
records.backing_decision: Tokenized private-credit and asset-backed collateral represented through SPCT structures.
records.redemption_decision: Direct mint and redemption are limited to approved institutional parties; retail holders generally use market liquidity.
records.income_decision: Base USDz does not automatically pass through RWA yield; sUSDz is the staking representation.
records.deployment_decision: Ethereum and Arbitrum contracts are documented; Base and Blast references require reconciliation.

records.name: Avalon USDa
records.identity_decision: Avalon USDa is the base Bitcoin-backed CDP token; sUSDa and lending receipts are separate.
records.backing_decision: Bitcoin and supported crypto collateral in CDP and CeDeFi structures.
records.redemption_decision: Borrowers repay USDa to close debt positions; universal holder redemption into BTC collateral is not established.
records.income_decision: Base USDa does not intrinsically accrue yield; holders enter the separate sUSDa savings representation to earn protocol yield.
records.deployment_decision: Official documentation describes multiple networks; canonical contracts and bridge rules remain required.
